legacy.original_title: 1.2 - Adopt the game-kit contract for state, actions, and rules
legacy.body:
## Summary

Implement the shared `game-kit` contract so Logic Grid exposes one deterministic
game core for the client, solver, and training.

## Context

`src/lib.rs` is a one-line comment and `Cargo.toml` does not depend on
`tools/game-kit`. The shared crate already defines `Action`, `GameState`, and
`Game`.

## Expected outcome

- `logic-grid` implements `game_kit::Game`.
- State and action types are explicit and serializable.
- `apply` is deterministic and rejects illegal actions.
- `legal_actions` is complete for every reachable state.
- The core has no browser or rendering code.

## Out of scope

- Puzzle generation.
- Browser UI.
- Solver optimization.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] `Cargo.toml` depends on a pinned `game-kit` version.
- [ ] `State`, `Action`, and `Game` are implemented.
- [ ] Illegal actions return `None` and never panic.
- [ ] Replaying the same seed and actions produces identical state.
- [ ] A conformance test covers initial state, legal actions, and apply.
- [ ] No browser dependency is added to the core crate.

## Plan

- [ ] Map the Logic Grid rules to the traits.
- [ ] Add serialization.
- [ ] Add the conformance test.
- [ ] Document invariants in `docs/`.

## Validation

- [ ] Same seed + actions = same state hash.
- [ ] Invalid action is rejected.
- [ ] `cargo test` passes.

## References

- Shared contract: tools/game-kit
- Boundaries: ops/templates#31
- Shared contracts: ops/templates#32
- Tests: ops/templates#34
